senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced.) connection, son-in-law; bridegroom; (metaph., with ref. to the covenant of circumcision, v. בְּרִית) the infant fit for circumcision.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 98b:6">B. Bath. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ הדר וכ׳</he> a son-in-law who lives in the house of his father-in-law.
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:11">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> <he>הוי זהיר … מחָתְנָהּ הראשון</he> guard thy wife against her former affianced.

Y. Ned. III, end, 38ᵇ (ref. to Ex. IV, 24 sq) משה קרוי ח׳ Moses is called the ḥathan … (and she said) חָ׳ דמים מתבקשין ממך (ed. מתבקש) husband, blood (circumcision) is asked of thee; תינוק קרוי ח׳ the infant is called the ḥathan, (and she said) חָ׳ בדמים אתה עומד לי child of the covenant, a high price I pay for thee; Bab.
<cite ref="Nedarim 32a:2">Ned. 32ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 5:8">Ex. R. s. 5</cite> <he>חָתְנִי תהיה את וכ׳</he> thou shalt be my affianced by covenant, thou art given to me &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 5:3">Nidd. V, 3</cite> an infant one day old … is <he>לאביו … כח׳ שלם</he> (as regards mourning ceremonies) like a perfect circumcised child to his parents &c.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 2:5">Ber. II, 5</cite> <he>ח׳ פטור וכ׳</he> a bride-groom in the first night is exempt &c.
Keth. 8ᵃ (in wedding benedictions) משמח ח׳ עם הכלה who causest the bridegroom to rejoice with the bride; a. fr.—Trnsf. (cmp. בַּעֲלָא) the fructifying rain.

<cite ref="Berakhot 59b:6">Ber. 59ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Taanit 6b:15">Taan. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>משיצא ח׳ לקראת כלה</he> when the bridegroom goes forth to meet the bride, i.e. when the falling rain-drops meet the water on the ground and bubble; [oth. opin.; when the rivulets formed by the rain meet each other in gutters.].—Pl. <he>חֲתָנִים</he>. Keth. l. c. Ib.ᵇ, v. <cite ref="B01292"><he>בְּרָכָה</he></cite>; a. fr.—
